title: Point Hunt
description: Adds A Point System To Minecraft
body:
Adds a type of point game/challenge to your server (Paper), where killing mobs or mining ore awards the player points.

1. To use it download the .jar file and download Paper 1.21.8 at  
https://papermc.io/downloads/paper.
   
2.  Make a startup Script at https://docs.papermc.io/misc/tools/start-script-gen and paste that for the line 2: java -Xms8192M -Xmx8192M -jar **paper-1.21.8-60.jar** nogui (if you want to keep your settings only paste paper-1.21.8-60.jar into the correct position)
   
3.  Then put both into the same folder and then run the .bat. Accept the Eula will appear as a text file in the folder save the file and run the .bat again.
   
4.  Now stop the server in the terminal with the stop command and then add the .jar of my plugin into the plugin folder and start the server again.
   
5.  Now go to Multiplayer --> Direct Connection, type localhost and have fun! 

6. Also do op name(Your MC name) command in the terminal to get access to all commands.

If it says no Java etc. go here: https://docs.papermc.io/misc/java-install/

type /hunt to see all available commands and to start type /hunt setTimer Time(e.g. 1h)

**Made By MicahCode**
